decisions.reason: The compact dumper builds directly on the firm's established construction machinery knowledge, keeps its own page, and the firm can interpret its results and improve it with in-house R&D.
The articulated dumper sits squarely within the firm's core competence, where its engineering experience and own R&D give it strong absorptive capacity to refine the product.

Although the rescue vehicle is distant from the core offer and was downgraded to a mere mention in 2024, it draws on the firm's underground vehicle expertise and serves a niche safety market, so withdrawal within a year is possible but less likely than retention.
The compact telescopic loader line with several models extends established lifting and loading know-how and remains prominently presented, signalling continued commitment.
The material lift line is close to the core business, and a large rental order confirms strong demand that the firm readily recognises and builds on.

Despite its distance from the core offer, the mining loader shows quantified field success (1,000 operating hours in 7 months), and these results give the firm interpretable learning to absorb and improve the product with its own R&D.
